'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**[[Germany|German]] vehicle manufacturer [[Daimler Truck]] announces it will cut around 5,000 jobs in the country by 2030 in an effort to save {{Euro}}1 billion following a drop in sales. [https://www.dw.com/en/daimler-truck-to-cut-5000-jobs-in-germany-by-2030/a-73200970 (DW)] 
*[[Bulgaria and the euro]]
**The [[European Parliament]] and the [[European Council]] approve [[Bulgaria]]'s request to adopt the [[euro]], which will replace the [[Bulgarian lev|lev]] as Bulgaria's official currency on 1 January 2026. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/07/08/european-parliament-approves-bulgarias-adoption-of-the-euro (''Euronews'')] [https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2025/07/08/bulgaria-ready-to-use-the-euro-from-1-january-2026-council-takes-final-steps/ (European Council)]
